continuity: Jeok Cheongang has pushed beyond his prior limits and is close to defeating the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord has lost both arms and a leg, but summons Heaven's Slaughter as a last resort.
A flaming spear interrupts Heaven's Slaughter's attack on Jeok Cheongang; its wielder is not yet identified.
plot: Jeok Cheongang overwhelms the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord with the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist, destroying both arms and a leg and driving him into the ground. As the Demon Lord faces defeat, he summons the assassin Heaven's Slaughter; just as the assassin launches a surprise attack, a flaming spear cuts through the air.
